legend: The Winter holiday will be here soon. Mr. Chanek wants to decorate his house's wall with ornaments. The wall can be represented as a binary string $$$a$$$ of length $$$n$$$. His favorite nephew has another binary string $$$b$$$ of length $$$m$$$ ($$$m \leq n$$$).
Mr. Chanek's nephew loves the non-negative integer $$$k$$$. His nephew wants exactly $$$k$$$ occurrences of $$$b$$$ as substrings in $$$a$$$.

However, Mr. Chanek does not know the value of $$$k$$$. So, for each $$$k$$$ ($$$0 \leq k \leq n - m + 1$$$), find the minimum number of elements in $$$a$$$ that have to be changed such that there are exactly $$$k$$$ occurrences of $$$b$$$ in $$$a$$$.

A string $$$s$$$ occurs exactly $$$k$$$ times in $$$t$$$ if there are exactly $$$k$$$ different pairs $$$(p,q)$$$ such that we can obtain $$$s$$$ by deleting $$$p$$$ characters from the beginning and $$$q$$$ characters from the end of $$$t$$$.
input: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$m$$$ ($$$1 \leq m \leq n \leq 500$$$) — size of the binary string $$$a$$$ and $$$b$$$ respectively.
The second line contains a binary string $$$a$$$ of length $$$n$$$.
The third line contains a binary string $$$b$$$ of length $$$m$$$.
output: Output $$$n - m + 2$$$ integers — the $$$(k+1)$$$-th integer denotes the minimal number of elements in $$$a$$$ that have to be changed so there are exactly $$$k$$$ occurrences of $$$b$$$ as a substring in $$$a$$$.
note: For $$$k = 0$$$, to make the string $$$a$$$ have no occurrence of 101, you can do one character change as follows.
For $$$k = 1$$$, you can also change a single character.

note.ai: 对于 $$$k = 0$$$，要使字符串 $$$a$$$ 中不出现 101，可以进行如下的一次字符修改。
对于 $$$k = 1$$$，你也可以修改一个字符。
对于 $$$k = 2$$$，无需进行任何修改。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$m$$$($$$1 \leq m \leq n \leq 500$$$)——分别表示二进制字符串 $$$a$$$ 和 $$$b$$$ 的长度。
第二行包含一个长度为 $$$n$$$ 的二进制字符串 $$$a$$$。
第三行包含一个长度为 $$$m$$$ 的 01 串 $$$b$$$。

output.ai: 输出 $$$n - m + 2$$$ 个整数——第 $$$(k+1)$$$ 个整数表示 $$$a$$$ 中需要修改的元素的最少数量，使 $$$b$$$ 作为子串在 $$$a$$$ 中恰好出现 $$$k$$$ 次。

legend.ai: 寒假很快就要到了。Chanek 先生想用装饰品装饰自家房屋的墙壁。墙壁可以表示为一个长度为 $$$n$$$ 的二进制字符串 $$$a$$$。他最喜欢的侄子还有另一个长度为 $$$m$$$ 的二进制字符串 $$$b$$$($$$m \leq n$$$)。
Chanek 先生的侄子喜欢非负整数 $$$k$$$。他的侄子希望 $$$b$$$ 作为子串在 $$$a$$$ 中恰好出现 $$$k$$$ 次。
然而，Chanek 先生不知道 $$$k$$$ 的值。因此，对于每个 $$$k$$$($$$0 \leq k \leq n - m + 1$$$)，求必须修改 $$$a$$$ 中元素的最小数量，使得 $$$b$$$ 在 $$$a$$$ 中恰好出现 $$$k$$$ 次。
如果存在恰好 $$$k$$$ 个不同的对 $$$(p,q)$$$，使得从 $$$t$$$ 的开头删除 $$$p$$$ 个字符、从末尾删除 $$$q$$$ 个字符后可以得到 $$$s$$$，则称字符串 $$$s$$$ 在 $$$t$$$ 中恰好出现 $$$k$$$ 次。
